doc: Governed adapters for third-party widgets and custom elements (LCP-021): maps, charts, editors, payment fields, Web Components. The application registers each adapter explicitly, by id and version. The engine mounts one into a slot named in HTML (data-adapter-slot) and then drives it only through serializable props and commands, under an opaque instance id; the adapter speaks only through JSON facts. No DOM node, widget object or engine internal crosses. Every adapter call is fault-isolated: a throwing adapter is quarantined and reported, and nothing else is affected. Adapters run with the page's authority; registering one is a trust decision (docs/42).

types.name: AdapterRef
types.doc: An adapter the engine was built against. version must equal the registered adapter's version exactly: a different version is a different contract.

types.name: SlotTarget
types.doc: An element named in HTML by data-adapter-slot; key selects a row by the nearest data-adapter-key ancestor. The adapter owns the slot's contents while mounted.

types.name: InstanceId
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack and meaningless anywhere else.

variants.name: command
variants.doc: An imperative request the widget understands (zoom, reset, focus a field). Its answer is JSON.

variants.name: unmount
variants.doc: Unmount and empty the slot. The instance id is Stale afterwards, even if the adapter throws.

variants.name: UnknownAdapter
variants.doc: No adapter with this id was registered by the application.

variants.name: VersionMismatch
variants.doc: The registered adapter has another version.

variants.name: SlotOccupied
variants.doc: Another instance is mounted in this slot; unmount it first.

variants.name: Faulted
variants.doc: The adapter threw, or answered with something that is not JSON. The instance is quarantined: every later update and command answers Faulted until it is unmounted. reason is the exception's name only.

variants.name: AdapterEvent
variants.doc: Something the widget reported (a point selected, a value changed). data is JSON; it is the widget's observation, which the engine may adopt into its own state.

variants.name: AdapterFaulted
variants.doc: A fault outside any request: the adapter emitted something that is not JSON, or emitted after being quarantined or unmounted. The instance is quarantined.

variants.name: SlotRemoved
variants.doc: A projection removed the slot's element; the pack unmounted the instance, and its id is Stale.
